```{r}

#we created hyphend ID but not added in BCL7A table
#our previous BCL7A table contains dot formate, so we will replace dotted one with hyphened RNA IDs before merging both datasets


BCL7A_table$TCGA_ID <- hyphened_RNA_IDs
head(BCL7A_table)


combined_data <- merge( #merge function check $TCGA IDs on both datasets and find commons and give new data containing only intersecting ones
  BCL7A_table,
  methylation_table,
  by = "TCGA_ID"  #intersecting by TCGA-ID names
)

dim(combined_data)
View(combined_data)

colnames(combined_data)
```
